summary: One-time lazy initialization of a subsystem guarded by a static flag. When dword_8D5A4C is zero, calls sub_596E40(-3) to initialize the subsystem and sets dword_8D5A4C = 1; subsequent calls are no-ops. Returns the initialization result.

local_names.sub_596E40: subsystem initializer invoked with the literal -3

operations.description: One-time-init guard: when dword_8D5A4C is zero, run the subsystem initialization; the flag prevents re-entry afterwards.
Call sub_596E40(-3) to initialize the subsystem with the literal parameter -3.
Return the initialization result; called by sub_592A9C, sub_592AF4 and sub_592BAD. The legacy ABI label is One_time_initialization_of_a_subsystem_guarded_b.

unresolved: When dword_8D5A4C is already set, the raw source leaves result undefined (compiler artifact); the function likely returns the first-call result only.
The meaning of the literal -3 passed to sub_596E40 is unknown.
